# AI 芯片市场格局：训练与推理竞争力比较

## 核心结论
现有证据仅能支撑 **NVIDIA 一侧**的竞争力描述；AMD、Intel、华为昇腾、寒武纪均**无一手数据**，无法完成跨厂商对比。以下按证据强度分层陈述。

## NVIDIA：训练与推理均有可引用证据
- **推理**：Blackwell Ultra（GB300 NVL72）官方称面向 agentic AI 推理“最高 50x 性能提升、35x 更低成本”，微软、CoreWeave、OCI 已规模化部署，用于低延迟/长上下文场景；使能要素为 NVFP4、NVLink/NVLink Switch、Dynamo + TensorRT-LLM、SGLang/vLLM [s_f6f6f452c0a6]。该倍数为**厂商自述营销口径**，非第三方复现。
- **基准**：MLPerf Inference v6.0 中 Blackwell Ultra 系统在最多模型/场景取得最高吞吐；NVIDIA 自 2018 年累计训练+推理胜场 291 次，为其他所有提交方合计的 9x；本轮 14 家伙伴参与 [s_f600a45f3f4e][s_267fa508d06b]。注意：此为 NVIDIA 对 MLPerf 结果的**自述**，未取得 MLPerf 官方榜单原文。
- **路线图**：Vera Rubin 平台 2026-01-05 发布“六颗新芯片、一台 AI 超算”，2026-03-16 增补第七颗芯片（Groq 3 LPX 低延迟推理加速器），定位以数据中心为计算单元、面向长上下文/agentic 推理 [s_1d2abc303176][s_1c7e1fc9369c]。**未取得** HBM 容量/带宽、FP4 算力等具体规格。

## AMD / Intel：证据缺失
两次 `site:amd.com` 检索返回 0 条，检索预算耗尽，**未获得任何 AMD（MI350/MI355X、MI400/Helios）或 Intel（Gaudi 3）官方规格与基准**。因此无法就训练或推理给出与 NVIDIA 的对比结论。

## 中国厂商：证据缺失
- `site:huawei.com` 命中均为无关文档（Atlas 300I 推理卡手册、OptiX RTN 910 微波设备、ATN 910C 路由器、鲲鹏 S920X10K），**无一条涉及昇腾 910B/910C 规格或性能**；support.huawei.com 部分页面因 SSL 校验失败无法读取 [s_20581477fb31][s_b0693111ec09]。
- `site:cambricon.com` 返回 **0 条**，思元 590/690 无官方页面命中。
- 缺口：昇腾 910C 算力/带宽/互联参数、思元 590/690 规格与量产状态、CANN/MagicMind 生态成熟度、2025–2026 出货与客户案例。

## 证据缺口与建议
本报告无法回答“训练 vs 推理”的跨厂商排序。建议改用非站点限定关键词（如“昇腾 910C 规格 算力”“思元690 发布”），或直接读取华为全联接大会/昇腾社区、寒武纪年报与投资者关系公告、SemiAnalysis 等第三方拆解。

**总体置信度：0.35**（NVIDIA 部分约 0.8；AMD/Intel/中国厂商部分接近 0）

**关键来源**：NVIDIA Developer 官方博客与产品页（推理平台、MLPerf v6.0、Vera Rubin 平台）[s_f6f6f452c0a6][s_f600a45f3f4e][s_267fa508d06b][s_1d2abc303176][s_1c7e1fc9369c]；华为支持站点检索结果（仅证明检索失败，非产品证据）[s_20581477fb31][s_b0693111ec09]。

现有证据仅能支撑 **NVIDIA 一侧**的竞争力描述；AMD、Intel、华为昇腾、寒武纪均**无一手数据**，无法完成跨厂商对比。以下按证据强度分层陈述。

- `site:huawei.com` 命中均为无关文档（Atlas 300I 推理卡手册、OptiX RTN 910 微波设备、ATN 910C 路由器、鲲鹏 S920X10K），**无一条涉及昇腾 910B/910C 规格或性能**；support.huawei.com 部分页面因 SSL 校验失败无法读取 [s_20581477fb31][s_b0693111ec09]。

本报告无法回答“训练 vs 推理”的跨厂商排序。建议改用非站点限定关键词（如“昇腾 910C 规格 算力”“思元690 发布”），或直接读取华为全联接大会/昇腾社区、寒武纪年报与投资者关系公告、SemiAnalysis 等第三方拆解。

**NVIDIA（官方来源，nvidia.com）**
- Blackwell Ultra（GB300 NVL72）：官方称面向 agentic AI 推理“最高 50x 性能提升、35x 更低成本”；微软、CoreWeave、OCI 已规模化部署 GB300 NVL72，用于低延迟/长上下文场景（agentic coding）。关键使能：NVFP4、NVLink/NVLink Switch、Dynamo + TensorRT-LLM、SGLang/vLLM。来源：https://developer.nvidia.com/topics/ai/ai-inference （2026-05）

- AMD MI350/MI355X、MI400/Helios 与 Intel Gaudi 3 的官方规格与基准：第二次检索（site:amd.com）返回 0 条，且检索预算耗尽，**未获得任何 AMD/Intel 一手数据**，无法给出跨厂商竞争力对比。

Understanding AI Inference
Today's AI applications, powered by frontier
mixture-of-experts (MoE)
, introduce a critical deployment challenge: achieving uncompromising performance at scale. The core difficulty is the fundamental trade-off between user experience and total output. Specifically, you must constantly balance user interactivity—the low latency a seamless user experience demands—against total throughput—the maximum volume of work your system can handle.
An effective AI deployment can't just be fast at one point; it must perform across the full spectrum of operational demands. This complete performance profile is mapped by the Pareto frontier. The NVIDIA inference platform is engineered to lead this frontier across all operating points, ensuring you can deploy the right solution to maximize your system's efficiency and minimize cost per token for every workload.
NVIDIA Inference Tools for Every AI Developer
Choose your optimal path for deploying high-performance AI inference on NVIDIA. For developers who need full control, customization, and ultimate optimization for LLM performance, NVIDIA Dynamo and NVIDIA TensorRT™-LLM enable you to serve all AI models—across any framework, architecture, or deployment scale. If you manage your own GPU-accelerated infrastructure but want simplified software deployment, NVIDIA NIM™ provides containers to self-host inferencing microservices for pretrained and customized AI models. Developers needing a fully managed, instant, serverless AI inference solution get auto-scaling, cost-efficient GPU utilization, and multi-cloud flexibility with NVIDIA DGX™ Cloud Serverless Inference. Find the right balance of control, speed, and ease for your AI in production.
Learn More About NVIDIA’s Inference Performance
NVIDIA TensorRT LLM
TensorRT-LLM is an open source library for high-performance, real-time LLM inference on NVIDIA GPUs. With a modular Python runtime, PyTorch-native authoring, and a stable production API, it’s optimized to maximize throughput, minimize costs, and deliver fast user experiences.
Get Started With TensorRT LLM
NVIDIA Dynamo
NVIDIA Dynamo is an open source, low-latency inference framework for serving generative AI models in distributed environments. It scales inference workloads across large GPU fleets with optimized resource scheduling, memory management, and data transfer, and it supports all major AI inference backends, including open source frameworks SGLang and vLLM.
Get Started With
NVIDIA Dynamo
NVIDIA NIM
NVIDIA NIM™ provides easy-to-use microservices for secure, reliable deployment of high-performance AI inferencing across the cloud, data center, and workstations.
Get Started With NIM
NVIDIA DGX Cloud Serverless Inference
NVIDIA DGX™ Cloud offers high-performance, serverless AI inference with auto-scaling, cost-efficient GPU utilization, and multi-cloud flexibility.
Get Started With DGX Cloud Serverless Inference
Lower cost per token comes from turning individual optimizations into system-level performance. NVIDIA’s inference software stack does this by connecting three layers:
Production Operation
: Coordinates distributed serving, orchestration, autoscaling, and memory management so inference can run across the right compute and storage resources.
Application Acceleration
: Runs models with high performance while giving developers room to tune and customize, using runtime optimizations such as overlapping compute and communication and kernel fusion.
Infrastructure Access
: Exposes NVIDIA GPU, networking, memory, and system capabilities without requiring developers to manage every device instruction set or data-transfer protocol directly.
The NVIDIA software stack spans model serving, runtime scheduling, kernels, communication libraries, and hardware-aware optimizations, enabling rapid performance gains and lower serving costs as improvements compound across layers.
NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra Delivers up to 50x Better Performance and 35x Lower Cost for Agentic AI
Built to accelerate the next generation of agentic AI, NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra delivers breakthrough inference performance with dramatically lower cost. Cloud providers such as Microsoft, CoreWeave, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure are deploying NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems at scale for low-latency and long-context use cases, such as agentic coding and coding assistants.
This is enabled by deep co-design across NVIDIA Blackwell, NVLink™, and NVLink Switch for scale-out; NVFP4 for low-precision accuracy; and NVIDIA Dynamo and TensorRT LLM for speed and flexibility—as well as development with community frameworks SGLang, vLLM, and more.
